title: ToolFence: Fine-Grained Authorization for Secure Tool-Using LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.37196v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tool-using LLM agents remain vulnerable to indirect prompt injection because trusted instructions and untrusted observations share one context, allowing malicious content to steer consequential input-filtering defenses. Multi-path consensus defenses still leave a high attack success rate because they examine content or aggregated outputs rather than authorizing effects, especially for the within-tool attack, which preserves the intended tool but manipulates its arguments. Data-Flow Control such as CaMeL provides stronger guarantees, but incurs substantial time latency that limits practical deployment. We introduce ToolFence, which compiles a typed authorization blueprint before execution, enforces it through a deterministic monitor, and when the blueprint is incomplete asks a judge to grant new capabilities rather than adjudicate each concrete call. translated_title: ToolFence：面向工具使用型LLM智能体安全的细粒度授权机制
translated_abstract: 使用工具的LLM智能体仍然容易受到间接提示注入攻击，因为可信指令和不可信观察共享同一上下文，使恶意内容能够操纵具有关键影响的输入过滤防御。多路径共识防御仍然留下较高的攻击成功率，因为它们检查的是内容或聚合输出而非授权效果，尤其是对于工具内攻击，这种攻击保留预期的工具但操纵其参数。数据流控制方法（如CaMeL）提供了更强的保证，但会产生显著的时间延迟，限制了实际部署。我们提出了ToolFence，它在执行前编译一个类型化的授权蓝图，通过确定性监视器来强制执行该蓝图，当蓝图不完整时，请求判定者授予新能力，而不是对每个具体调用进行裁决。ToolFence提供了两个关键优势。首先，其细粒度的溯源感知授权……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ToolFence针对工具使用型LLM智能体的间接提示注入漏洞，通过执行前编译类型化授权蓝图并用确定性监视器强制执行，以细粒度的溯源感知授权防御工具内攻击，同时避免了数据流控制方法的高延迟问题。
en_tdlr: ToolFence defends tool-using LLM agents against indirect prompt injection—especially within-tool attacks—by compiling a typed authorization blueprint before execution and enforcing it through a deterministic monitor, offering fine-grained provenance-aware authorization without the substantial latency of data-flow control methods like CaMeL.
